claims.evidence: Species is Gigantopithecus blacki (paper) but NCBITaxon has no entry for it (esearch 0 hits; parse_sdrf rejects the species name); PRIDE organism is NEWT:9604 Hominidae. Family-level term used; species recorded in report.
Methods: two enamel and one dentine sample from molar CF-B-16; file names Enamel_HCL, Enamel_TFA, Dentine_HCL4.

claims.value: Hydrochloric Acid / Trifluoroacetic Acid / Hydrochloric Acid
claims.evidence: One enamel and the dentine sample demineralized in 1.2 M HCl, other enamel in 10% TFA, 3 C, 24 h.
File 1335_Blank.raw has no sample; paper mentions both negative extraction blank and injection/system wash blanks, file does not say which.
Raw headers of 1332, 1334, 1335 read Q Exactive HF-X; 1333 header unreadable (truncated response), instrument taken from paper and run series.
Digestion-free protocol, no protease; MaxQuant Enzyme mode Unspecific; PEAKS enzyme None.

claims.value: Variable: Oxidation M, Oxidation P, Deamidated N, Deamidated Q, Gln->pyro-Glu, Glu->pyro-Glu, Phospho STY; no fixed
claims.evidence: MaxQuant summary.txt variable list: Oxidation (M);Hydroxyproline;Gln->pyro-Glu;Glu->pyro-Glu;Deamidation (NQ);Phospho (STY), no fixed; PEAKS pep.xml lists the same masses (+15.99 on M and others, +0.98 N/Q, +79.97 STY, -18.01 E, -17.03 Q). Hydroxyproline written as UNIMOD:35 on P.
